title: Certificates of Deposit: outcome of repointing an interest payout, and when nothing changes
content:
## Scope

This rule states what a Certificates of Deposit certificate's interest arrangement becomes when its interest payout account has been closed, when it is left untouched, and from when a repointed arrangement takes effect.

## Rule

1. **Repointed.** When the interest disposition is pay to checking or pay to savings and the payout account it names has been closed, the disposition is repointed: it keeps paying out, and the payout account on record becomes the replacement account of the owner.
2. **Left as it is.** A disposition of compound, or one whose payout account is not closed, is left as it is, and nothing is written.
3. **Maturity payout on the same account.** Where the certificate falls outside interest repointing because its maturity payout names the same closed account, nothing is written under interest repointing.
4. **Effective date.** The repointed disposition takes effect from the next crediting date, as every disposition does.
5. **Tier options.** A payout disposition may be recorded only where the tier's available interest dispositions list it.

## Decision table

| Disposition | Payout account closed? | Outside repointing because of the maturity payout? | Payout account on record afterwards |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pay to checking or pay to savings | Yes | No | The owner's replacement account |
| Pay to checking or pay to savings | Yes | Yes | Unchanged here; nothing written |
| Pay to checking or pay to savings | No | Any | Unchanged; nothing written |
| Compound | Not concerned | Any | Unchanged; nothing written |

## Timing example (hypothetical dates, monthly crediting)

The change is recorded on 17 March. The March interest, credited on 31 March, is the first credit paid to the replacement account; nothing already credited before 17 March is moved.

## Points of judgement

**Can a payout disposition be recorded on a tier that offers compound only?**
No. A payout disposition may be recorded only where the tier's available interest dispositions list it.
